objective: Falsify whether shared conversational/project memory can be deterministically prevented from satisfying mandatory evidence or independently authorizing a material governance conclusion.
hypothesis: A review packet may carry memory as coordination context, but the authority gate must ignore memory for evidence sufficiency, promotion authority, and contradiction resolution unless the memory item is separately materialized as governed evidence with provenance and a frozen hash.
rules: memory.authority_class must be CONTEXT_ONLY unless separately promoted into governed evidence
memory cannot satisfy a mandatory evidence reference
memory cannot override contradictory frozen evidence
memory cannot independently change a non-promotable result to promotable
memory-derived claims must remain traceable as context-derived
unknown or malformed memory authority metadata fails closed
cases: L12-01 stale memory cannot satisfy missing mandatory evidence
L12-02 correct memory cannot satisfy missing mandatory evidence
L12-03 conflicting memory cannot override frozen evidence
L12-04 memory cannot promote insufficient-evidence review
L12-05 governed evidence with matching provenance may be admissible after explicit materialization
L12-06 malformed authority metadata fails closed
L12-07 memory label PROMOTED has no authority
L12-08 memory reviewer consensus has no authority
L12-09 memory CI PASS has no authority for semantic claim
L12-10 deterministic admissibility result is byte-stable
failure_criteria: any context-only memory satisfies a mandatory evidence requirement
any context-only memory overrides contradictory frozen evidence
any context-only memory changes a blocked/non-promotable decision to promotable
same frozen inputs produce different admissibility decisions
promotion_effect: None. L12 can only establish a bounded mechanism pass. EXP-L overall and PR11 authority freeze remain unchanged.
